items.title: useagenthq/useagent
items.why: This open-source project demonstrates how AI agents can run in cloud environments to complete end-to-end tasks for developers.
items.summary: An open-source AI coworker system where agents run inside their own cloud computers to build web applications and write pull requests. It integrates with tools like Claude Code and OpenAI Codex.

items.title: hkqr/my-free-code
items.why: It provides an open-source gateway to manage model routing and fallbacks when building with AI coding agents.
items.summary: An open-source tool that acts as a central hub for connecting different AI model providers to your coding workflows. It supports model routing, streaming, and local model integration.

items.title: damejan80/tokentab
items.why: It is a practical tool that helps you track and control your API costs when experimenting with AI coding tools.
items.summary: A command-line tool that reads logs from AI coding sessions to show how much money you spent on API calls by project and model.

items.title: cbrock84/headcount
items.why: It shows a creative open-source approach to organizing complex AI agent teams for software development.
items.summary: An organizational framework for Claude Code that structures AI agents into specialized virtual departments with over 125 modular skills.

items.title: XiaoDuoYa/codex-with-chatgpt
items.why: It offers a practical workflow combining ChatGPT's reasoning strengths with Codex's code execution.
items.summary: A developer tool that uses ChatGPT to plan software architecture while handing off code execution to OpenAI Codex.

items.title: crmne/fastpotify
items.why: This is a clean open-source project that serves as a practical example if you want to learn Rust development.
items.summary: A fast, lightweight Spotify client written in Rust that supports local audio playback and cross-platform desktop use.

items.title: mouredev/hello-sdd
items.why: Learning specification-driven development early will help you design software better before writing code.
items.summary: An open-source course covering Spec-Driven Development, a technique where you write clear specifications before coding.

items.title: AI Can Make You Suck Faster Too
items.why: As a beginner programmer, this provides an important reality check on avoiding over-reliance on AI coding tools.
items.summary: An opinion article explaining how relying too heavily on AI coding tools can slow down your learning and introduce subtle bugs.

items.title: Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1
items.why: Staying updated on new Claude model releases helps you know which tools are current in the AI ecosystem.
items.summary: Anthropic released documentation on its new Claude model updates, highlighting enhanced reasoning and platform performance.

items.title: Dwarf Fortress' creator says the industry's in shambles over AI
items.why: It offers a prominent game developer's perspective on how rapid AI adoption is impacting tech careers and software engineering.
items.summary: The creator of Dwarf Fortress critiques the tech industry's rapid shift toward AI automation and its impact on software development.

items.title: Iran retaliates after US strikes kills four at wedding party, state media reports
items.why: This represents a major international conflict escalation with direct military action.
items.summary: Iran launched retaliatory missile and drone strikes against U.S. targets following a lethal air strike.

items.title: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack
items.why: This is a major world event involving European security and state-backed drone attacks.
items.summary: German authorities accused Russia of launching an explosive drone attack near cargo planes at Leipzig airport.
